title: High earners
description: Return the name and salary of employees who earn more than 70000.
expected_query: SELECT name, salary FROM employees WHERE salary > 70000;

title: Customers from the UK
description: Return the names of customers whose country is 'UK'.
expected_query: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE country = 'UK';

title: Recent hires in Sales
description: Return the names of employees in department 2 who were hired in 2018 or later.
expected_query: SELECT name FROM employees WHERE hire_year >= 2018 AND department_id = 2;

title: Top-level mid earners
description: Return the names of employees who have no manager and earn between 60000 and 100000 (inclusive).
expected_query: SELECT name FROM employees WHERE manager_id IS NULL AND salary BETWEEN 60000 AND 100000;
